Blu Pantera Tech Pty Ltd
Fortitude Valley, Brisbane QLD 4006

$140,000 – $180,000 per year + superannuation

About position
The SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) Consultant is responsible for analysing business requirements, and designing, configuring and implementing SAP EAM solutions that optimise asset management and maintenance processes for clients operating in asset-intensive industries. The role partners with business stakeholders to maximise asset reliability, reduce maintenance costs and support digital transformation through effective SAP EAM solutions, while ensuring project delivery meets quality standards, timelines and client requirements.

Responsibilities
- Consult with clients, users and stakeholders to understand organisational objectives, operational requirements and asset management needs.
- Identify, investigate and analyse business processes, procedures and work practices to determine inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.
- Define, document and validate functional requirements for SAP solutions supporting asset management and maintenance operations, and recommend process improvements and system enhancements.
- Design, configure and implement SAP Enterprise Asset Management (EAM) solutions aligned with operational requirements and industry best practice, including asset structures, functional locations, equipment records, maintenance notifications, work orders, preventive and corrective maintenance processes, maintenance plans and maintenance strategies.
- Develop functional specifications, data and process models, system documentation and process maps to support SAP solution design, configuration and development.
- Collaborate with technical consultants, developers and project teams to deliver integrated SAP solutions that meet business requirements and technical standards.

- Prepare user documentation, business process documentation and training materials, and deliver formal training to end users.
- Provide post-implementation support, troubleshoot functional issues and monitor SAP EAM processes and performance to identify improvements.
- Act as a central functional reference point throughout project delivery, liaising with clients, users, project managers, developers and cross-functional teams to ensure solutions meet requirements, quality standards and project objectives.

Skills and Qualifications required to perform the above job role
- Tertiary qualification in Information Technology, Computer Science, Business Information Systems or a related discipline. 
- SAP certification or relevant SAP EAM/PM training is highly regarded.
- Minimum of 5 years' experience implementing and supporting SAP Enterprise Asset Management (SAP EAM/PM) solutions.
- Strong business analysis skills, with the ability to identify business requirements, analyse processes and develop functional specifications, process models, documentation and test plans.
- Experience in project management, with strong analytical, problem-solving and organisational skills, and the ability to oversee the implementation of complex IT projects.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage with technical teams, business stakeholders and end users.

About Us

We're not like other digital marketing companies.

We are a consulting-led agency. What does that mean? It means our sole focus is driving profitable growth for our clients' businesses.

It means we are platform and channel-agnostic. We look at where clients want to go and tell them the best way to get there, even if that means taking a road less travelled.

We work with some of the world's best-known companies, including innovative scale-ups, large global brands and private equity firms, to deliver visionary yet pragmatic solutions to their unique challenges.

We (and our clients!) consider us experts in media buying & advertising, creative, SEO, social media management, content, web analytics & attribution, website development, conversion rate optimisation, and UX/UI consulting.

We service clients across Australia and the US, with most of our team based in Sydney and a number of key team members working remotely around the world. We currently operate on a hybrid model, with Tuesdays and Thursdays in the office.

Our culture is built on innovation, diversity and excellence. Most importantly, we genuinely care about each other, which makes working at Orange Line that much better.

Reporting to the Outreach & Comms Lead, the Outreach Manager will play a key role across digital PR, outreach, content and SEO & GEO. This is a broad, hands-on role where you'll manage outreach campaigns, build client relationships and collaborate closely with the SEO & GEO team to drive meaningful results.

You'll progressively take ownership of campaigns, support the growth of the outreach function and, within your first six months, be ready to manage a junior team member while developing a strong understanding of the commercial side of the business. The role is designed to evolve around your strengths, interests and the changing agency landscape.

You Will Be Responsible For

- Managing outreach campaigns from prospecting through to content placements
- Building relationships with publishers, journalists, bloggers and website owners
- Acting as a trusted day-to-day contact for clients and presenting campaign insights
- Supporting digital PR initiatives and identifying reactive media opportunities
- Writing and editing outreach content when required
- Working closely with the Outreach & Comms Lead to grow the outreach offering
- Supporting and mentoring a junior Outreach team member
- Contributing to the commercial growth of the outreach business unit
- Collaborating with the SEO & GEO and content teams to deliver integrated campaigns

About You

- Excellent written and verbal communication skills with client-facing experience
- Strong organisation and project management skills with the ability to manage multiple campaigns
- Proven ability to build lasting relationships with clients, publishers and media contacts
- Curious, proactive and commercially minded, with a willingness to take ownership
- A collaborative team player who enjoys working across different disciplines
- Kind, emotionally intelligent and genuinely invested in helping others succeed

What's in It for You

- Awesome office located 15 minutes' walk from Central Station
- A company that genuinely believes in work/life harmony and flexibility
- Permanent hybrid model with Mon/Wed/Fri working from home and Tue/Thu in the office
- Clear learning and development pathways with defined career progression
- Work with leading Australian and global brands across a diverse range of industries
- Learn alongside subject-matter experts with years of industry experience

Role:

BatFast is a leader in global sports technology. Founded in 2016 to increase participation in sports worldwide. We use data, augmented reality technology, machine learning, and robotics to re-engineer how sports are played. We use technology to change the game. With data and patented technology, we’ve made sports more accessible for beginners and aspiring professionals alike - whether you're here to play, complete, or improve.

We currently innovate, design, develop, and build multisport simulators for training and entertainment industries. We have a great pipeline of products and features we are working on over the next few years. There will be many aspects of the business to get involved in within our highly dynamic, passionate, and ever-growing team.

The BatFast team is looking for a multi-skilled candidate with excellent interpersonal skills for the position of Services & Operations manager, who will help coordinate, develop and innovate the operational function within the business.

Responsibilities

? Innovation

- Advocate for sharing best practices and insights with other teams.

- Independently execute projects & initiatives, involving and delegating tasks to the team for collective success.

- Utilise cross-functional feedback to establish innovative and standardised approaches to work.

- Motivate the BatFast team members to share and fully implement new ideas

? Product Delivery

- Project manage installations in coordination with the Supply Chain Manager.

- Develop maintenance and service systems in line with site/machine requirements, working closely with the technical department.

- Train staff internally and externally on installation, production, assembly &

maintenance service as required.

- Development of risk assessments and health & safety systems.

- Foster a spirit of continuous improvement within the Operations team.

- Proactively identify and resolve obstacles for the team and ensure all SLAs are met.

- Implement standard practices with the team to ensure procedures are followed consistently

- Maintain high standards when ensuring all systems are utilised correctly by BatFast team members

- Play a crucial role in the successful execution of various large-scale and strategic programs and projects, engaging all stakeholders.

- Ensure clear project plans are agreed upon by the team.

? Client Success

- Drive client onboarding processes.

- Manage hands-on activities of the team, including assembly, deliveries, installations & packaging.

- Manage B2B customer relationships and ensure customer success.

- Support installations as required - finding suppliers, reducing installation time, and shipping costs.

- Effectively address challenges raised by stakeholders, to ensure a seamless client experience.

- Manage client expectations using product knowledge & experience.

- Establish targets for client service excellence, including NPS scores, and communicate them clearly to the entire team.

- Confidently handle client challenges and resolve issues to promote client success.

? Team

- Build, recruit, train and manage agency staff and interns supporting installations, production & maintenance.

- Collaborate with the Technical department and Supply Chain Manager to improve the production/assembly process.

- Provide operational leadership support for investment and raise conversations.

- Assist BatFast team members to develop individual skills.

- Provide mentorship and support to junior team members.

About You:

? Experience

- Relevant qualification such as Business, or equivalent professional experience.

- 5 years working in industry, (project management/client relationships)

- International experience - Collaborating with diverse stakeholders, managing global projects and navigating cross-cultural environments effectively.

- Tooling experience - the role involves working with specialised equipment and tools integral to the production and assembly processes.

- Understanding of the Sport industry - All 3 sports (Cricket, Baseball, & Tennis)

? Innovative thinking

- Ability to find creative solutions to challenges and adapt to changing market demands, by implementing new ideas.Adaptability

? Adaptability

- With shifting market trends, evolving customer preferences, and technological advancements, you must be adaptable to embrace change, and pivot strategies when necessary.

? Communication

- Effective communication is essential to convey expectations, align team members, and collaborate with various stakeholders.

? Team Management and Collaboration

- Effective team management involves motivating and empowering team members to achieve shared objectives.

- Openness to help the business in other departments in busy periods not directly linked to Services and Operations.

Extended Responsibilities

? Operational Strategy Delivery

- Take responsibility for supporting the implementation of BatFast’s operational strategy, ensuring that day to day operations and international projects are aligned and within budget.

- Create and implement a sustainable support and service structure for the Australian market ensuring budget constraints are met.

- Own and manage BatFast Australia stock to meet cost efficiency measures.

- Create Australia's supply chain for cost effective and scalable deployment

? Resource and Supply Planning Responsibility

- Responsible for building the Operations team in Australia in a cost-effective manner, such that the business is profitable and can scale.

- Be accountable for providing accurate data, forecasts and recommendations to inform operational resources and supply planning in line with the sales pipeline. Ensure resource plans are delivered effectively within assigned projects.

- Report and monitor client performance metrics, usage patterns, SLA’s and satisfaction levels to ensure optimal outcomes and proactively address any issues before they impact the relationship.

? Client Success Ownership

- Supporting commercially for region wide business developments as and when requested to ensure the success of BatFast in Australia

- Take responsibility for identifying and resolving operational barriers that may affect

client delivery within international projects, ensuring issues are escalated appropriately and client expectations are met.

? Budget Responsibility

- Monitor and track costs within assigned projects, ensuring efficiencies are achieved and escalating budgetary concerns where required, escalating financial decisions to the Head of operations

- Clear focus on reducing costs to supply, install, train, service and maintain for the Australian business to be successful in scaling

? Team Mentorship & Coaching

- Provide day to day coaching, guidance and support for operational team members and agency staff on-site, enabling effective delivery of installations, services and maintenance.

- Full performance management accountability for all staff locally

? Account Management

- Serve as the primary point of contact for all BatFast Australian clients, building and maintaining strong, long-term relationships that drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.

- Proactively identify and close opportunities to grow revenues with existing clients

- Take accountability for revenue growth from existing Australian accounts, and achieve annual revenue growth & NPS targets

- Oversee contract renewals, negotiations, and variations, ensuring terms are mutually beneficial and support long-term partnerships

result.description:
Our client, Hecho En Mexico South Fremantle, operates as a well-regarded Mexican restaurant in South Fremantle, Western Australia 6162. Known for its welcoming atmosphere and commitment to culinary excellence, the establishment offers a memorable dining experience that highlights bold Mexican flavours, seasonal ingredients, and a strong connection to quality service. With a loyal customer base and a reputation for consistency, it is a popular destination for both locals and visitors.

About the Role:

The business is currently seeking an experienced full-time Restaurant Manager to oversee the day-to-day operations of the restaurant. The role offers a competitive salary of $75,000 to $85,000 per annum plus superannuation, commensurate with experience. This is an excellent opportunity for a motivated hospitality professional to take on a leadership role, ensuring the smooth operation of both front-of-house and overall restaurant activities. You will play a key role in leading the team, maintaining high standards of customer service, coordinating daily operations, and supporting the continued success and growth of the business.

Key Responsibilities:

•	Work with our Chefs to plan and update menus based on seasonal ingredients and customer preferences.
•	Coordinate private functions, group bookings, and special events held at the restaurant.
•	Order food, beverages, and other supplies while monitoring costs and budgets.
•	Maintain stock records, sales reports, and other operational and financial records.
•	Ensure the restaurant complies with food safety, health, and workplace regulations at all times.
•	Monitor customer feedback and resolve service issues to maintain a positive dining experience.
•	Recruit, train, roster, and supervise front-of-house staff while coordinating with the kitchen team.
•	Manage reservations, welcome guests, and oversee the smooth flow of restaurant service.
•	Monitor daily restaurant operations to ensure efficient service, staffing, and customer satisfaction.
•	Work with the management team to develop promotional activities and seasonal campaigns to increase customer patronage.
•	Conduct regular team meetings and monitor staff performance to maintain service standards and support ongoing development.

Qualifications:

•	Must possess a minimum of a Bachelor's degree in Business or a related field.
•	Should have at least one (1) year of relevant managerial experience in the hospitality industry.

Note: Australian citizens and permanent residents are preferred.

result.description:
We are looking for an experienced and strategic ICT Manager to lead the planning, development, and day-to-day management of our organisation's information and communication technology systems. This role is central to ensuring our technology infrastructure supports business objectives effectively and securely. The ideal candidate will bring strong technical knowledge, sound leadership capability, and the ability to translate complex ICT requirements into practical solutions. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to drive digital initiatives and maintain a reliable, secure, and efficient ICT environment.
Key Responsibilities
Analyse organisational information needs and specify appropriate technology solutions to meet current and future business requirements
Formulate, implement, and continuously review ICT strategies, policies, and operational plans aligned with broader organisational goals
Direct the evaluation, procurement, and installation of ICT hardware, software, and infrastructure, ensuring value for money and fitness for purpose
Oversee the security and integrity of all ICT systems, including risk assessments, data protection compliance, and incident response planning
Set priorities and allocate resources across system development, maintenance, and daily operations to ensure continuity of service
Lead and manage the ICT team, including recruitment, performance management, professional development, and workload planning
Direct the provision of user training and technical support, ensuring staff are equipped to use systems effectively
Manage vendor and contractor relationships, including negotiating contracts, monitoring service levels, and ensuring delivery against agreed outcomes
Develop and manage ICT budgets, tracking expenditure and identifying opportunities for cost optimisation without compromising performance
Oversee the implementation of new systems and technology projects, managing timelines, risks, and stakeholder communication throughout
Ensure ICT operations comply with relevant legislation, industry standards, and internal governance frameworks
Produce and present regular reports on ICT performance, project progress, and strategic initiatives to senior leadership
Required Qualifications & Skills
Bachelor's degree or higher in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related discipline
Proven experience in an ICT management or senior technical leadership role, typically five or more years
Demonstrated ability to develop and implement ICT strategies, policies, and operational frameworks
Strong knowledge of network infrastructure, systems administration, cybersecurity principles, and cloud-based technologies
Experience managing budgets, vendor contracts, and procurement processes within an ICT context
Solid understanding of data privacy legislation and information security standards, including ISO 27001 or equivalent
Excellent leadership and people management skills, with the ability to mentor and develop technical teams
Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, with a structured approach to decision-making
Effective communication skills, with the capacity to convey technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders
Experience delivering ICT projects using recognised project management methodologies such as PRINCE2 or Agile
Preferred Qualifications
Postgraduate qualification in IT management, business administration, or a related field
Relevant professional certifications such as ITIL, PMP, CISSP, or equivalent
Experience working within regulated industries or government environments
Familiarity with enterprise resource planning (ERP) or customer relationship management (CRM) platforms
Knowledge of COBIT or other IT governance frameworks
Experience leading digital transformation or large-scale systems migration projects
Why Join Us?
Be part of a collaborative and forward-thinking organisation that genuinely values technology as a driver of business success
Access ongoing professional development opportunities, including funded certifications and leadership programmes
Enjoy flexible working arrangements, including hybrid work options to support work-life balance
Receive a competitive remuneration package with superannuation and performance-based incentives
Contribute to meaningful projects that have a real impact on organisational outcomes and service delivery
Job Details
Job Type: Full-time, Permanent
Work Schedule: 8-hour shift
Salary: $70,000 – $120,000 per year + Super
